description: Unit test class for the ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder class, testing immutability, equality, and header resolution.

classes.name: ImmutableHeadersPlaceholderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior (immutability, equality, header resolution) of ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before any tests run; sets up header map with device_id and correlation_id.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder instances are immutable using MutabilityAssert.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods in ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testReplaceDeviceIdHeader
methods.description: Tests that the resolve method correctly retrieves the device_id header value.

methods.name: testUnresolvableHeaderReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that when an unresolvable header name is used, an empty Optional is returned.
